title: biodiversity and stability of microbial ecosystems using microbial electrolysis cells
description: We constructed a series of biofilm communities with different biodiversity by diluting the input source community. Then the responses of different biofilms in facing pH sharp decrease were monitored. High-throughput sequencing of 16S ribosomal RNA (rRNA) genes was used to assess the diversity of anodic microbial communities in MEC.
center: Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences
